GeneDef.label: natural leader
GeneDef.description:
Carriers of this gene develop a set of mental, emotional, and psychic traits that make them naturally adept at leading others.

Carriers gain access to a special social interaction, which can temporarily boost the working speed of the recipient, as long as they do not also carry this gene.

Carriers who are greedy, jealous, or abrasive will exude a greater sense of authority, and are more effective when using inspired leadership.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Requires the carrier to have a special title or role.
Can inspire others to work faster by interacting with them.
